text:
alerts-bot: ALERT: hosted-usw2-gpu-pool saturation detected — p95_queue_time=152s, queue_len=420, admission_rejects=18/min. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted/usw2-gpu-pool

maria (oncall): Oncall here, looking. Any customer errors?

devon: Seeing a bump in 502s from proxy and increased tail latency on hosted endpoints. A handful of healthcheck evictions too.

maria (oncall): Opening pool details — most pressure on g4-large family, KV cache miss rate up. Admission control is throttling some low-priority traffic.

akira: Can we route non-critical traffic to euw1 fallback? We have spare capacity but model pinning might mismatch.

devon: euw1 has capacity but defaults to model v1.4 while production is v1.6. v1.4 is slower but compatible. We can do partial fallback to reduce queue.

maria (oncall): Temporary plan: enable euw1 fallback at 20%, trigger emergency scale +4 nodes in usw2, and investigate SNAT/egress that might be causing proxy retries. Agreed?

platform-bot: Command acknowledged: initiating 20% cross-region fallback to euw1 for hosted-models group. Rolling change — estimated ramp 90s.

devon: Starting scale-up: running terraform apply to add +4 gpu nodes to hosted-usw2 autoscaling group. Cost impact ~ $3k/day.

noah: Noted related net noise — saw SNAT port exhaustion on a small egress subnet earlier, causing backend connection resets. Opening a ticket with net infra and adding temporary NAT pool.

maria (oncall): Also adding temporary admission bump for reserved customers only so we don't blow budget for hosted. Will keep throttles for anonymous traffic.

platform-bot: Scale complete: +4 nodes joined hosted-usw2 pool, autoscaler now shows +6% headroom. Fallback ramp at 20% completed.

alerts-bot: RECOVERY: p95_queue_time=45s, queue_len=80, admission_rejects down to 2/min. Incident state: recovered.

akira: Follow-ups: 1) lower scale-up threshold to react faster, 2) revisit SNAT capacity and allocate larger NAT pool for frontend subnets, 3) add version-compat check for cross-region fallback to avoid slow-model surprises. I'll file tickets.

devon: Adding a quick notes snippet for postmortem in #postmortems. Devops cost tag attached to this scale event. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): Thanks team — monitoring for 1h then close. If anything regresses ping me.
